name: Stop
meaning: Stop before the STOP line, give way to traffic on the major road, and enter only when the way is clear.
meaning_hi: स्टॉप लाइन से पहले रुकें, मुख्य सड़क के यातायात को रास्ता दें और रास्ता साफ होने पर ही आगे बढ़ें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.5.3

name: Give Way
meaning: Slow down, give way to traffic on the major road, and proceed cautiously.
meaning_hi: धीमे हों, मुख्य सड़क के यातायात को रास्ता दें और सावधानी से आगे बढ़ें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.6.2

name: No Entry
meaning: Vehicles must not enter from this direction.
meaning_hi: इस दिशा से वाहनों का प्रवेश मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.17

name: No Parking
meaning: Parking is prohibited here.
meaning_hi: यहाँ पार्किंग मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.8.5

name: No Overtaking
meaning: Overtaking other vehicles is prohibited.
meaning_hi: दूसरे वाहनों को ओवरटेक करना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.20

name: Speed Limit 40
meaning: Do not exceed 40 km/h.
meaning_hi: 40 किमी/घंटा से अधिक गति न रखें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.9.8

name: No Horn
meaning: Sounding the horn is prohibited.
meaning_hi: हॉर्न बजाना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.16

name: No U-Turn
meaning: U-turns are prohibited.
meaning_hi: यू-टर्न लेना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.21

name: No Right Turn
meaning: Right turns are prohibited.
meaning_hi: दाएँ मुड़ना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.19

name: No Left Turn
meaning: Left turns are prohibited.
meaning_hi: बाएँ मुड़ना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.19

name: Ahead Only
meaning: Vehicles must go straight ahead only.
meaning_hi: वाहन केवल सीधे जाएँ।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.11.2

name: Compulsory Turn Left
meaning: Vehicles must turn left.
meaning_hi: वाहन को बाएँ मुड़ना अनिवार्य है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.11.3

name: Left Hairpin Bend
meaning: Sharp bend to the left ahead; slow down.
meaning_hi: आगे बाएँ तीखा मोड़ है; गति धीमी करें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.5

name: Narrow Bridge
meaning: The bridge ahead is narrow; slow down and take care.
meaning_hi: आगे पुल संकरा है; धीमे चलें और सावधानी रखें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.20

name: School Ahead
meaning: School nearby; expect children, slow down.
meaning_hi: पास में स्कूल है; बच्चों की आशंका, धीमे चलें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.28

name: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: Pedestrian crossing ahead; be ready to stop.
meaning_hi: आगे पैदल पारपथ है; रुकने के लिए तैयार रहें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.27

name: Men at Work
meaning: Road works ahead; slow down and be careful.
meaning_hi: आगे सड़क का काम चल रहा है; सावधानी से धीमे चलें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.34

name: Cattle
meaning: Animals may be on the road; slow down.
meaning_hi: सड़क पर पशु हो सकते हैं; धीमे चलें।
sourceDoc: Not yet confirmed against an official source

name: Slippery Road
meaning: Road may be slippery; reduce speed, avoid sudden braking.
meaning_hi: सड़क फिसलन भरी हो सकती है; गति कम करें, अचानक ब्रेक न लगाएँ।
sourceDoc: Not yet confirmed against an official source

name: Roundabout
meaning: Roundabout ahead; slow down and give way to traffic already on it.
meaning_hi: आगे गोलचक्कर है; धीमे हों और उस पर पहले से चल रहे यातायात को रास्ता दें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.12

name: T-Junction
meaning: Road ends at a T-junction ahead.
meaning_hi: आगे सड़क टी-चौराहे पर समाप्त होती है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.14

name: Parking
meaning: A designated parking place.
meaning_hi: यह निर्धारित पार्किंग स्थान है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 3.3 (facility signs)

name: Hospital
meaning: A hospital is nearby; drive quietly, avoid horn.
meaning_hi: पास में अस्पताल है; शांति से चलाएँ, हॉर्न न बजाएँ।
sourceDoc: Not yet confirmed against an official source

name: Petrol Pump
meaning: Fuel station ahead.
meaning_hi: आगे ईंधन स्टेशन है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 3.3 (facility signs)

name: First Aid Post
meaning: First aid is available here.
meaning_hi: यहाँ प्राथमिक उपचार उपलब्ध है।
sourceDoc: Not yet confirmed against an official source

name: Telephone
meaning: A public telephone is available.
meaning_hi: यहाँ सार्वजनिक टेलीफोन उपलब्ध है।
sourceDoc: Not yet confirmed against an official source

name: Eating Place
meaning: Food is available nearby.
meaning_hi: पास में भोजन उपलब्ध है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 3.3 (facility signs)

name: Resting Place
meaning: A place to rest is nearby.
meaning_hi: पास में विश्राम स्थल है।
sourceDoc: Not yet confirmed against an official source
